owner.description: The ID of mock server's owner.

collection.description: The unique ID of the mock's associated collection.

config.description: Information about the mock server's configuration.

createdAt.description: The date and time at which the mock server was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time at which the mock server was last updated.

environment.description: The unique ID of the mock's associated environment.

matchBody.description: If true, the mock server matches the request's body to the body of the saved examples.

matchHeader.description: If true, the mock server matches the request's headers in the `header` array to the headers of the saved examples.

headers.description: A list of header key values.

matchQueryParams.description: If true, match query parameters to the saved examples.

matchWildcards.description: If true, use wildcard variable matching.

delay.description: Information about the mock server's simulated network delay settings. This returns a null value if there are no configured network delay settings.

serverResponseId.description: The ID of mock server's default response for requests. All calls to the mock server will return the defined response.

MockCreateUpdateResponseMockConfig.description: Information about the mock server's configuration.
MockCreateUpdateResponseMockConfig.title: MockCreateUpdateResponseMockConfig

duration.description: For custom network delays, the custom configured delay, in milliseconds.

preset.description:
The simulated fixed network delay value:
- `1` — 2G (300 ms).
- `2` — 3G (100 ms).
The object does not return this value for custom delay values.

MockCreateUpdateResponseMockConfigDelay.description: Information about the mock server's simulated network delay settings. This returns a null value if there are no configured network delay settings.
